title: Choose the field guide's visual world
question: Which world should carry the same verified curriculum from notebook question to equation, code, experiment, and evidence?

options.label: Pipeline Debugger
options.lineage: compiler IR viewers, tensor inspectors, and GPU timeline debuggers
options.thesis: Learn the LLM lifecycle by single-stepping it and probing every tensor, recipe choice, and released artifact.
options.viewport: A narrow lifecycle rail on the left, a live token-to-report execution trace in the center, and a proof inspector on the right; a blue probe opens the first derivation in place.
options.risk: Dense instrumentation can intimidate unless the reading path and beginner explanations stay obvious.

options.label: Training Score
options.thesis: Training becomes a vertical score where symbol shape is operation, fill is confidence, and block length is compute or duration.
options.case: Fits simultaneous training phases beautifully, but its unfamiliar reading direction makes first-use clarity weaker than the debugger.
options.viewport: A vertical center staff rises through data, model, train, eval, and serve; paired side lanes hold equations and system evidence while the active beat exposes a lesson.
options.risk: The notation itself needs teaching before it can teach the model.

options.label: Data Sublime
options.thesis: Every scale, token, expert, and latency sample becomes a black-and-white field that can be sampled down to its source.
options.case: The audience recognizes measurement density, but pure abstraction obscures the novice's explanatory path.
options.viewport: A full-width lifecycle barcode dominates the fold; selecting a frequency band pulls one concept, equation, and code trace into focus beneath it.
options.risk: Long reading can become visually severe and the blue-dot source artifact disappears.

options.label: Quoted Systems
options.lineage: industrial stockroom labels and streetwear quote grammar
options.thesis: Every ambiguous term is literally labeled, quoted, and left tagged until its evidence is verified.
options.case: Literal labels support evidence status, but the fashion lineage identifies less strongly with sustained systems study.
options.viewport: A diagonal verification stripe crosses a three-zone study map; quoted term plates detach into definitions, equations, and code trails.
options.risk: The hazard language can overstate routine uncertainty and fatigue the reader.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished documentation portal with a sidebar, chapters, conventional diagrams, and interactive labs.
canonCard.viewport: A familiar course landing page and table of contents, executed at full craft without an unusual governing metaphor.
